dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 12, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**HOMERS AND SHUTDOWNS LIGHT UP MLB**

In a busy day of baseball, several players made their mark on the game. Liam Hicks of the Miami Marlins led the way with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs in the Marlins' 8-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Sandy Alcantara pitched 8 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 3 earned runs, to earn the win.

On the other side of the country, Bryce Miller of the Seattle Mariners was equally impressive, tossing 8 shutout innings and fanning 7 batters in the Mariners' 10-2 victory over the Washington Nationals. Dominic Canzone had a 2-hit, 1-home run day, driving in 3 runs.

In other action, Yordan Alvarez of the Houston Astros hit 2 home runs and drove in 6 runs in a 10-8 Astros win over the Kansas City Royals. Bo Bichette of the New York Mets homered twice and drove in 6 runs in a 7-5 Mets victory over the Atlanta Braves.
